question:
Directions: Each item in this section consists of a sentence with an underlined word followed by four words/group of words. Select the option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the answer sheet accordingly.

The artist skilfully captured the __intricate__ contours of the mountain range.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **'Complex'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Intricate : (जटिल)** - Very complicated or detailed.

 
 
• **Example:** The carpet had an intricate pattern.
 
 
 
• **Complex: (जटिल)** - Composed of many interconnected parts; complicated.
 
 
• **Example: **The issue is complex and it cannot be resolved easily.
 
 
 
• Hence, **Complex **is the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Complex'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Systematic: (तंत्रित)** - Done or acting according to a fixed plan; methodical.

 
 
• **Example:** He was systematic in his research.
 
 
 
• **Fantastic: (अद्भुत)** - Extraordinarily good or attractive.
 
 
• **Example: **The performance was simply fantastic.
 
 
 
• **Reasonable: (तर्कसंगत)** - Fair, sensible.
 
 
• **Example:** His suggestions were quite reasonable.
 
 
 
• ***Contours :** **(किसी वस्‍तु की बाह्य आकृति; रूपरेखा)** - An outline representing or bounding the shape or form of something.*
 
 
• ***Example:** The contours of the landscape were stunningly beautiful.*
